records.source_evidence:
Degenerativne promjene FP i FT zgloba uz rubne koštane apozicije i gotovo potpunu denudaciju kosti
u medijalnom kompartmentu zgloba
records.reason: Near-complete denudation of bone in the medial compartment is a broad compartment-level description of cartilage absence: depth is full thickness and near-complete regional exposure provides qualitative qualifying extent. This is not an isolated unmeasured fissure or a bare OA/grade number. No numeric centimeter measurement is claimed.

records.source_evidence:
Defekt pune debljine femoralne hrskavice u području lateralnog kompartmenta ispunjen
intralezijskim osteofitom.
records.reason: Definite full-thickness lateral femoral cartilage defect establishes depth, but no dimension or broadly affected region is stated. Intralesional osteophyte does not provide cartilage-defect extent. Keep missing-extent uncertainty.

records.source_evidence: Stanjena patelarna hrskavica u lateralnoj faseti sa par fisura pune debljine.
records.reason: Patellar thinning with a couple of full-thickness fissures identifies deep focal lesions but not a qualifying >=1 cm region. The dimensions and broader thinning depth are unspecified; separate fissures cannot be summed to assume extent. Keep uncertainty.

records.source_evidence: No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
records.reason: This excludes significant marrow-signal abnormalities, not explicitly all marrow edema or bone contusions. The contusion target has no minimum-volume or significance threshold, and small contusions can qualify. No separate normal marrow or no-contusion statement supplies the missing exclusion. Preserve qualified-normality uncertainty rather than assume a clinically significant threshold.
